answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The juniper is the serial tenure, the ridge the custody window that must elapse, and the trellis the standing released at the end of it; the juniper is personal, the ridge is not skippable, and the trellis cannot be inherited by a sibling.
